title: Pitch Tuner announcement
description: One announcement at a time, read by the app at launch and shown on the next launch. Anything the app can't read shows nothing.

id.description: Each user sees an id once. Change it for a new announcement; keep it when only fixing the same one.

expires.description: UTC instant after which it no longer shows.

text.description: Keyed by lowercase language code. The user's first matching language wins, else en; with neither, nothing shows.

platforms.description: Omit to show on every platform.

minVersion.description: Lowest app version that shows it, inclusive. 2.14 equals 2.14.0.

maxVersion.description: Highest app version that shows it, inclusive.

url.description: Adds Learn more / Not now, which open it; omit for a single OK. HTTPS on these hosts only, or nothing shows.
